about: Acceptance of W0-T08: GATE-facts fails on a fixture sentence whose tagged value disagrees with its run. The sentence states 212 distinct states (BRIEF section 2.2 lists that number as known-false); the record says 11.

runs.what: the sentence states 212 distinct states; RUN-tlc-doublespend records 11

findings.detail: does not state RUN-tlc-doublespend#values\.deadlock_off\.distinct_states, which is 11; it states "212 distinct states"
